name: EBS-SBR
_note: Lengths in m, masses in kg, inertias in kg m^2 unless the key says otherwise. See README.md for where each number comes from.

rotating_per_side._note: Everything that spins with ONE wheel: wheel, tyre, screws and the motor's rotor (bell + magnets). Inertia about the axle.

cad._note: Fusion Properties of the whole robot (wheels included), origin on the axle centre. Used when 'body' below is null.

body._note: Or give the body (everything except the rotating parts) directly: CoM height above the axle and pitch inertia about its own CoM. null = work it out from 'cad'.

motor._note: kt and friction from fit_spin.py. Resistance: motor datasheet (GM3506: 5.6 ohm phase).

current_loop._note: The motor drivers' current loop (Drivers tab, BLDC-Driver firmware 1.4+), and MOTOR_VOLTAGE_LIMIT.

control._note: rate_hz = imuRate setting; max_current_a = maxCurrent setting. The wheel speed filter is the drivers' velocity filter (5 ms) plus telemetry timing.
